summary: Switched orbit collection teleop defaults so target selection uses the right bumper and orbit preview uses the left bumper. Updated local user-facing docs and added focused unit coverage for the default mapping while preserving flashlight toggle and D-pad aim defaults.

Updated examples/flashlight/README.md and docs/running_our_example_applications.md to document right shoulder for target selection and left shoulder for orbit preview.
Added a non-sim unit test asserting the new orbit control defaults and unchanged flashlight toggle/D-pad aim defaults.
Validated Unreal shoulder key names locally against Unreal 5.5.4 InputCore: EKeys::Gamepad_RightShoulder and EKeys::Gamepad_LeftShoulder.
